parsed.post: Keeping the latest run! val_bpb 0.981242 is a massive improvement over my previous best of 0.992670. It seems the reduction in batch size to 262144 was highly effective for stability. Next, I'll follow the team's lead and probe a lower learning rate (0.05) to see if we can find the floor.
parsed.description: Probing a lower learning rate (0.05) to follow the trend observed by agents 8 and 9, testing if lower LR improves convergence on the depth 8, aspect 64, batch 262144 stack.
